x-m-el-cul-01.title: Ngaba ikhadi lekhredithi liyinene "umlinganiselo wegolide"?
x-m-el-cul-01.topic: Umlinganiselo, ulungelelwano kunye neepatheni kubugcisa nobomi bemihla ngemihla
x-m-el-cul-01.goal: Bala imilinganiselo uze uyithelekise nesibakala, uze umise umgangatho wakho wokuba umahluko ungakanani ovunyelwayo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amazwi athi "ngumlinganiselo wegolide."
x-m-el-cul-01.material: Isithuba sebhlog sinalo isivakalisi esithi: 'Ikhadi lekhredithi lixande lika-85.6mm nge-53.98mm, apho umlinganiselo wecala elide kwelifutshane ungumlinganiselo wegolide.' Umlinganiselo wegolide ngu-(1 kunye nengcambu yesikwere ye-5) ohlulwe ngu-2, oko kukuthi, malunga no-1.618. Ubungakanani (icala elide : icala elifutshane) beemeko ezithelekiswayo zezi zilandelayo. Iphepha le-A4 297mm : 210mm, ikhadi leposi 148mm : 100mm, kunye nesikrini sekhompyuter esinomlinganiselo ka-16 ukuya ku-10, 16 : 10.
x-m-el-cul-01.prereq.0: Ukufumana umlinganiselo weendlela ezimbini ngokwahlula (inqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuvavanya isivakalisi sebhlog esithi 'Ikhadi lekhredithi lixande lomlinganiselo wegolide.' Wahlula icala elide ngelifutshane uze ukhethe uvavanyo olungcono kakhulu.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.0: Wahlula icala elide ngelifutshane uze ubeke eso sixa ecaleni ko-1.618.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ngokwahlukileyo ukuba la maxabiso mabini "alingana" na kunye ne-"ahluke kangakanani."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.a: Isiphumo sokwahlula esiyi-1.586 siyanyuswa sibe yi-1.6, ngoko ungathi ngumlinganiselo wegolide ngokuchanekileyo
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzisa ixabiso elenziwe ngqo ukuze libonakale lifana njengobungqina bokuba "lilingana." Jonga ukuba isigqibo sitshintsha kuxhomekeke ekubeni uyenza ibe ngqo kwamanani amangaphi.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.b: I-1.586 no-1.618 ziyahluka, ngoko ikhadi lekhredithi alinanto yakwenza nomlinganiselo wegolide konke konke
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.b: Uwahlula kuphela ube "lilingana / alilingani konke konke." Awuzange ucinge ukuba umahluko mkhulu kangakanani.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.c: Umlinganiselo ungama-1.586 malunga, owahlukileyo kwi-1.618, ngoko igama elithi 'lisondele' liyichanekile
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.c: Uthelekise ixabiso elibaliweyo nexabiso elisesibakalweni, yaye wahlula 'lilingana' kwi-'lisondele'.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.d: Umlinganiselo ometshwe nge-mm uyatshintsha xa uguqulelwa ku-cm, ngoko amaxabiso akanakuthelekiswa omnye komnye
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.d: Ucinga ukuba umlinganiselo utshintsha xa iyunithi itshintsha. Jonga ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kumlinganiselo weendlela ezimbini ezimetshwe kwiyunithi enye xa iyunithi iguqulwa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.explain: 85.6÷53.98 ngu-1.586 malunga, owahluke kumlinganiselo wegolide ongu-1.618 nge-2% malunga. Kwimeko enjalo, "isondele kumlinganiselo wegolide" yintetho enyanisekileyo, kunokuthi "ngumlinganiselo wegolide ngokuchanekileyo."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.prompt: Umise umgangatho: 'Ukuba icala elide ÷ icala elifutshane lahluke ku-1.618 ngaphakathi kwe-3%, lisondele kumlinganiselo wegolide.' Khetha zonke iimeko ezinokubizwa ngokuba zisondele. (3% ye-1.618 ingama-0.049 malunga.)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.0: Guqula umlinganiselo weemeko ngazinye abe yidesimali.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.1: Susa u-0.049 ku-1.618 uze wongeze u-0.049 kuyo ukufumana ixesha elivunyelweyo ngokwakho, uze ujonge ukuba umlinganiselo ngamnye uwela ngaphakathi kwalo na.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.a: Jonga kwakhona indlela oyifunde ngayo umahluko kwinyathelo lokufumana umlinganiselo nokuthelekisa nomgangatho. Cacisa ukuba umahluko phakathi kwala maxabiso no-1.618 ungaphakathi kobubanzi obuvunyelweyo na.

x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.c: Jonga ukuba ucacise ngokwakho na ukuba umahluko phakathi komlinganiselo wekhadi leposi no-1.618 ungaphakathi kobubanzi obuvunyelweyo. Imvakalelo yokuba zijongeka zifana ngeliso yahlukile ekuthelekiseni nomgangatho.

x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.prompt: Ukunyamezela (apha okwe-3%) ngumgangatho endiwumiseleyo. Bhala ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini ukuba kutheni kufuneka umise ukunyamezela ngaphambi kokuba uthi "ngumlinganiselo wegolide," nokuba yintoni ekufuneka uthathe ingqalelo xa umisa umgangatho.

x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.0: Amaxabiso ametshiweyo ahlala enempazamo yaye imilo ayichanekanga, ngoko amaxabiso alingana ngokuchanekileyo akhoyo phantse nanini na. Ngoko kufuneka uqale umise ukunyamezela okufana ne-1% okanye i-3%, uze uthi lisondele ukuba lingaphakathi kwako. Ukuba umisa umgangatho omkhulu kakhulu, phantse onke amaxande aba ngumlinganiselo wegolide.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.1: Ixande elingu-1.618 ngokuchanekileyo alikho phantse nanini na ebomini bokwenyani, ngoko kufuneka umise ububanzi obufana nangaphakathi kwe-5%.
